digest.component_or_area: code-review batch runner and gate dispatch
propositions: Activated project criteria are not injected into Round A/B batches; only static 13 built-in overlays execute, preventing project findings from being attributed with logical criterion ids.
CodeReviewBatchRunner iterates only req.criteria and stamps findings with reviewer_id=prompt_id without logical criterion_id, blocking attribution of project-sourced findings.
Project criteria must execute exactly once in Round A only and not consume the Round-B escalation cap; the runner serves both round_a and round_b steps and needs explicit Round-A-only branching.
Missing or malformed project criterion prompts should fail loudly with a located LLMError naming the logical criterion and expected .rebar/prompts path, preventing silent degradation to built-ins.
Findings from project criteria must retain any model-emitted criteria tags and append the logical criterion_id when absent, while preserving existing reviewer_id provenance.
